_comment: The image-model registry: what Kav knows about every provider and model. Adding or refreshing a model is an edit here plus a bake-off run, not a code change. `status` says how far a model got: recommended (our default) · tested (passed a bake-off on a real book) · untested (wired up, never judged) · not-recommended (tested and lost, with why). `verified_on` is the last date a human looked at its output or its docs; check_setup.py reports how old that is. Prices are rough per-image USD, for warning the author, not for billing.

aspects._comment: Panel shapes in pixels. Page cells are 4:5; a panel spans 1, 2 or 3 cells (4:5, 8:5, 12:5). Models that take a ratio rather than a size map these to their nearest own value.

fal.title: fal.ai
fal.notes: One key for both models. Takes Kav's full reference stack, which holds faces best.

seedream.title: Seedream 4.5
seedream.notes: Kav's default panel lane. Replayed ten picked panels of berko-and-olive and matched the book.

nanobanana.title: Nano Banana Pro
nanobanana.notes: Identity-strong for mug shots. In the roto bake-off it ignored the style pack for its own painterly look and drifted faces, at ~4x the price; not for that style. Rejects 8:5 and 12:5, which map to 16:9 and 21:9.

magnific.title: Magnific
magnific.notes: Formerly the Freepik API. Async: POST returns a task_id, then poll.

seedream.title: Seedream 4.5
seedream.notes: Passed the ten-panel bake-off: composition, style and identity all held. Its own slightly different look. Five references is the real limit — past three named subjects the style pack loses its slots. No 4:5: page cells come back 3:4.

higgsfield.title: Higgsfield
higgsfield.notes: Parked until an author who uses Higgsfield wants it. The client works — key accepted, references upload — but the test account had no credits, so no image has ever been judged. Cloudflare rejects a default Python user agent. The key is the key id and secret joined by ':'. Its catalogue is per account (its CLI lists 23 image models), so a future version should read the account's own list.

popcorn.title: Popcorn
popcorn.notes: The multi-reference lane, closest in shape to how Kav works.

soul.title: Soul
soul.notes: Higgsfield's own look. One style reference only, so it cannot hold a character's face across panels.

gemini.title: Google Gemini
gemini.notes: Nano Banana without fal.ai. Needs billing on the Google Cloud project behind the key.

nanobanana.title: Nano Banana Pro
nanobanana.notes: Same model and the same caveats as Nano Banana on fal.ai. KAV_GEMINI_MODEL overrides the model id.
